title: Editor Compressor
subtitle: Trim, resize, and compress your photos and videos in seconds — entirely on your device. No uploads, no watermarks, no waiting.

features.title: Trim in seconds
features.description: Cut photos and videos down to exactly the part you need, with a simple drag-to-trim editor.

features.title: Smart compression
features.description: Shrink file sizes dramatically while keeping the detail that matters — perfect for sharing.

features.title: 100% on-device
features.description: Nothing leaves your phone. No uploads, no accounts, no waiting on a server.
